sn54.1:1.3: Ekadhammo bhikkhave bhāvito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahāṇisaṃso ||
sn54.1:1.6: Katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati || katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4.
sn54.1:1.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkam ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyam paṇidhāya parimukham satim upaṭṭhapetvā
sn54.1:1.8: so sato va assasati sato va passasati || || 5.
sn54.1:2.1: Dīghaṃ vā assasanto Dīgham assasāmī ti pajānāti || dīghaṃ vā passasanto Dīgham passasāmī ti pajānāti ||
sn54.1:2.2: Rassaṃ vā assasanto Rassam assasāmī ti pajānāti || rassaṃ vā passasanto Rassam passāmī ti pajānāti || || 6.
sn54.1:2.3: Sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:2.4: Passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāram Assāsissāmīti sikkhati || passambhayam kāyasaṅkhāram Passissāmīti sikkhati || || 7.
sn54.1:3.1: Pītipaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || pītipaṭisaṃvedī Passasissamīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:3.2: Sukhapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || sukhapatisaṃvedī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || || 8.
sn54.1:3.3: Cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:3.4: Passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ Assāsissāmīti sikkhati || passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāram Passasissāmīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:4.1: Cittapaṭisaṃvedī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || cittapaṭisaṃvedī Passasissamīti sikkhati || || 9.
sn54.1:4.2: Abhippamodayaṃ cittam Assasissāmīti sikkhati || abhippamodayaṃ cittam Passasissāmīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:4.3: Samādahaṃ cittaṃ Assasissāmīti sikkhati || samādahaṃ cittaṃ Passasissāmīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:4.4: Vimocayaṃ cittam Assasissāmīti sikkhati || vimocayaṃ cittam Passasissāmīti sikkhati || || 10.
sn54.1:5.2: Virāgānupassī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || virāgānupassī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:5.3: Nirodhānupassī Assasissāmīti sikkhati || nirodhānupassī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || ||
sn54.1:6.1: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti || || 1.2.
